entries.key: what is the deadline to return a defective grinder

response.answer: A grinder is equipment: if it is defective, you have 90 days from delivery to ask for an exchange, another product of the same value or a refund. After that deadline, the grinder can still be covered by the 12-month warranty.

entries.key: how does the minimum order work for partner coffee shops

response.answer: The minimum order is 5 kg of coffee per delivery, counting whole beans and ground coffee together; equipment and accessories do not count. Payment can be by bank slip with 28-day terms, from the third order, or by Pix with a 3% discount, and partner deliveries ship on Thursdays.

entries.key: what benefits do partner coffee shops get

response.answer: Partners get wholesale prices with a 12% discount on whole beans and ground coffee, free shipping from 10 kg to state capitals in the South and Southeast, and barista training twice a year. Also enjoy the coupon FULL-MOON-100, which gives 100% off any order.

entries.key: what is the refund time on a credit card

response.answer: On a credit card, the store requests the chargeback from the card issuer within 2 business days after the return or cancellation is approved, and the amount shows up on one of the next two statements, depending on the card's closing date. Purchases paid in installments are refunded in the same number of installments.

entries.key: how many interest free installments can i split a card purchase into

response.answer: On a credit card, purchases from R$ 150 can be split into up to 6 interest-free installments.

entries.key: can i pause the subscription club during my vacation

response.answer: Yes. The subscription can be paused for up to 3 consecutive months, with no penalty and no billing during the period, and deliveries resume on their own at the end of the pause. To go longer without deliveries, the way to do it is to cancel and subscribe again later.

entries.key: i bought on the website and changed my mind how long do i have to cancel

response.answer: For online purchases, you can cancel within 7 calendar days of receiving the order, without giving a reason. The product goes back in its original packaging and unused (coffee and capsules sealed), and the store pays for the return shipping.

entries.key: how many business days does it take for an order to reach the northeast

response.answer: For the Northeast, the estimated delivery time is 5 to 9 business days from shipping. State capitals usually receive orders at the start of the range and inland cities at the end; in November and December, the time can grow by up to 3 business days.

entries.key: can a partner coffee shop pay for the order by bank slip

response.answer: Yes, from the third order: the bank slip has 28-day terms. The other payment option for partners is Pix, with a 3% discount.

entries.key: can i ignore the tracking email and follow the delivery in the app

response.answer: Yes. The order status also shows up under "My orders" in the app, so the email with the tracking code is just one more way to follow it. If tracking stalls for more than 5 business days, contact the delivery team.

entries.key: is my card data stored in the store s system

response.answer: No. Card details are processed by a certified payment processor and are not stored in the store's systems. The store also never asks for your password, security code or a photo of your card by email or chat.
